description: Transparent presentation of the three forecast-driving signals already emitted by the UIP-native Metals forecast cycle. These are not the retired v8 model families and must not be relabeled as bayesian_shrinkage, macro_view, or mean_reversion.
component_semantics: model_forecast is the native pre-bound annualized signal value for the named component; model_weight is the governed coefficient applied by the current UIP-native forecast formula. Rows are explanatory decomposition evidence, not independent predictive models.
forecast_run_id_semantics: YYYYMMDD integer derived from each forecast as_of_date; native presentation key only, not a legacy database run identifier.
